removed: Component testing moves to a stories and galleries model. A story wraps your component in one specific scenario — hard-coded props, mock data, providers — and a gallery page that you serve renders stories on demand. The new fixtures.mount() fixture navigates to the gallery, mounts a story by id, and returns a Locator scoped to the story's root element:
Pass a story type as a template argument to type-check its props, and use / on the returned locator to re-render or tear down within a test.
Most operations and web-first assertions now accept a option that takes an , letting you cancel long-running actions, navigations, waits, and assertions:
Providing a signal does not disable the default timeout; pass to disable it.
and can now store snapshots in the WebP format — just give the snapshot a name:
// Visual comparisons store the golden snapshot as lossless WebP.
// Standalone screenshots can trade quality for size with lossy WebP.
